name: accion-contextual
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. High fidelity raster design proposal for the EXISTING Yoyos native Android order detail, Operate mode. Create a tall portrait 1536x2304 comparison composition containing TWO portrait native screen panels side by side, each legible at 720px wide, including full content top to bottom (extended scroll capture, not a cropped viewport); small labels above panels. This is one proposal, not alternatives within it. References: images 1 and 2 are current detail ANTI-reference for redundant oversized controls, preserve their real data and navigation; images 3-5 provide REQUIRED visual grammar of the rest of app: calm cream #F7F4EF, white flat connected list groups, Inter, charcoal #242326, caramel #8C552D, thin warm separators, 8dp corners, 16dp gutters, native back and bottom four tabs Inicio/Catálogo/Pedidos/Ajustes with Pedidos selected. No shadows, gradients, phone frame, decorative illustrations, debug gear, tiny text. Preserve 48dp tappable rows, compact via grouping not shrinking. Main screen header back arrow 'Pedido #1001' and overflow menu. Date '8 oct. 2026 · 10:16 a. m.' and quiet 'Activa'. Buyer Público general, product Camisa QA Productos / SKU QA-CAM-001 / 1 × S/79.90. Products subtotal S/79.90, shipping S/0.00, total S/79.90, received S/0.00, balance S/79.90. Unpaid delivery cannot ship or deliver: show ONE plain reason, not disabled buttons. Paid with stock deducted can mark shipped OR directly delivered; show both valid choices compactly without changing rules. Edit/assign delivery remains distinct. Keep link, payment history, internal metadata and cancellation accessible through named rows. Link URL and seller technical ID not primary content. No invented tracking, dates, payment methods or domain features. Spanish UI text crisp.
OPTION B 'Acción contextual arriba'. Strong structural difference: compact task/payment summary first, then flat connected disclosure list like Inicio. NO product photographs or thumbnails (existing detail has none). Left panel 'B · Vista completa': back/header/date; buyer Público general as secondary identity, no separate card. One restrained white summary: 'Por cobrar' small label with 'S/79.90' prominent 26sp; small inline 'Total S/79.90 · Recibido S/0.00'; single caramel 'Registrar pago' 48dp button. Then white single connected list group, no separate islands: 'Productos · 1 unidad' expanded showing Camisa QA Productos, SKU QA-CAM-001, 1 × S/79.90, amount right; 'Desglose del total' chevron collapsed; 'Historial de pagos' chevron; 'Entrega' / 'Pendiente · Por definir' with right quiet 'Asignar'; below delivery single helper 'Completa el pago para enviar o entregar.'; 'Confirmación del comprador' / 'Enlace aún no habilitado' chevron; 'Detalles internos' chevron; 'Cancelar pedido' as last quiet text row. Tabs at bottom. No multiple top badges, no disabled shipping buttons, no huge buyer card.
Right panel 'Con pago cubierto · Detalles abiertos': identical structure header/date/buyer. Compact top task summary 'Pago cubierto' green check and S/79.90; 'Entrega pendiente' quiet line. Single caramel 'Actualizar entrega' control; immediately below its opened NATIVE compact popup menu showing equal simple text rows 'Marcar enviado' and 'Marcar entregado' (choices not oversized buttons). All lower content visible: Productos compact one-line row; Desglose del total expanded with Productos S/79.90, Envío S/0.00, Total S/79.90, Recibido S/79.90, Por cobrar S/0.00; Historial de pagos row; Entrega expanded showing Domicilio, right Editar, Ana Torres, 999 123 456, DNI 12345678, Av. Arequipa 120 Miraflores, Tocar el timbre; buyer confirmation expanded with Pendiente de confirmación and text actions Copiar enlace / Ver enlace; internal expanded Stock descontado, Costo interno S/0.00, Registrado por vendedor, ID vendedor usr_8d3a; Cancelar pedido quiet final row. Fine separators connect sections. Whole view including footer tabs must fit in long panel without clipping; no fake timeline or forced sequence, ability to directly deliver retained. Primary action area changes with eligibility, all other named actions remain discoverable. Empty history should be quiet no-payments detail, not fictional transactions.
renderCaveats: Generated paid-state subtitle Sin pagos registrados is inconsistent; use actual payment history.

functionalClarification.manualDeliveryData: Assigning or editing delivery data does not require payment. Keep the action available for active, non-cancelled orders with pending delivery, including unpaid and partially paid orders. Existing busy/recovery locks and data validation remain.
functionalClarification.fulfillment: Marking shipped or delivered is a separate operation. Preserve current full-payment, stock and state guards; do not infer rule changes from permission to edit data.
functionalClarification.presentation: Keep Asignar/Editar beside delivery data, separate from fulfillment actions and their payment explanation. All three existing raster proposals already show Asignar in the unpaid example; apply the same availability to Editar when data exists.
functionalClarification.verification: Source inspection only; no tests or native QA performed for this clarification.
